name: presence-avatars
title: Presence avatars
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Avatar stack for people in the room, with overflow, tooltips, a live dot, and an optional single avatar for all agents.

meta.descriptionEs: Pila de avatares con desborde, tooltip y un avatar único para los agentes.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero, uno, nombres largos y cuarenta.

api.name: groupAgents
api.description: One avatar for every isAgent user.

api.name: includeSelf
api.description: Include the local user. Default false.

docs: Requires PresenceProvider. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar or tooltip. Color comes from info.color or var(--chart-1) through var(--chart-5).
